description: This file is a shell script that contains a series of tests for verifying the behavior of 'git svn dcommit' with files that have unusual or 'ugly' names. It sets up a SVN repository, performs commit and rename operations, and checks the integration with Git and SVN, including handling of filenames with special characters and renames.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that expects success, runs a shell command sequence.

methods.name: prepare_utf8_locale
methods.description: Sets up the UTF-8 locale environment for testing filename encoding.
